author: Molly Riley, official White House photographer (Commons author field: The White House)
license: Public domain (PD-USGov, work of the U.S. federal government)
attribution: Official White House Photo by Molly Riley, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
notes: Sharpest face in the set: slight three-quarter view toward his right, neck and top of the chest piece ('…uffy' lettering) visible in the open black shirt. Night light with a cool, desaturated grade, so skin reads pinker/greyer than it is. The original EXIF carries the White House non-endorsement notice; do not use it in anything that implies endorsement.

author: Sgt. 1st Class Brittany Primavera, U.S. Army (DVIDS 9747950, VIRIN 260613-A-BN614-9806)
license: Public domain (PD-USGov-Military-Army); the usarmyband Flickr copy is tagged CC BY 4.0
attribution: U.S. Army photo by Sgt. 1st Class Brittany Primavera, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
notes: Walking down the Lincoln Memorial steps in a black shirt, three-quarter face toward his left, both hands open. Shows the beard length and point, the slicked-back hair and how he carries his shoulders. The same frame is also on Commons as '... June 12, 2026 - 28.jpg' (not downloaded again).

author: Daniel Torok, official White House photographer (Commons author field: The White House)
license: Public domain (PD-USGov-POTUS, work of the U.S. federal government)
attribution: Official White House Photo by Daniel Torok, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
notes: Black-and-white fight photo: Ruffy lunging in with a long right hand on a kneeling Michael Chandler (Ruffy won by R1 TKO at 4:29). Shows his long lunge stride, long arms and the white striped Freedom 250 shorts. His extended right arm is bare; ink shows on the top of the left shoulder.

author: Daniel Torok, official White House photographer (Commons author field: The White House)

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (photographer not credited), via ESPN
notes: Frontal head and shoulders. Best source for face proportions, brow, eyes, nose and beard outline. Swept-back quiff, short sides. Strong warm studio grade. Official UFC studio portrait served by ESPN's headshot CDN; date is the CDN Last-Modified header, so the shoot is on or before that date.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (photographer not credited), via ESPN
notes: Full body for UFC Freedom 250: white shorts with red and light-blue stripes, navy star waistband, red Freedom 250 gloves with US flag. Clearest view of the chest piece ('Ruffy' lettering and anime-style grinning figure) and the crowned skull and clock on the left forearm. Right arm bare. Official UFC studio portrait served by ESPN's headshot CDN; date is the CDN Last-Modified header, so the shoot is on or before that date.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (photographer not credited), via ESPN
notes: Full body for UFC 331: white UFC shorts with grey scalloped print and a black waistband panel. Clearest view of the left upper-arm sleeve (woman's face under an owl headdress with dotwork, geometric elephant at the elbow). Official UFC studio portrait served by ESPN's headshot CDN; date is the CDN Last-Modified header, so the shoot is on or before that date.

author: Gabriel Gonzalez / Cageside Press
notes: Face-off with Arman Tsarukyan; Ruffy shows his LEFT side, fists up. Shows a shaved hard part on the left side of the head, the skin fade, the beard point, and the chest and left-arm tattoos in arena light. Silver chain with a green pendant; sand-coloured UFC sweat shorts.

author: Gabriel Gonzalez / Cageside Press
notes: Face-off with Michael Chandler, three-quarter view of his left side in daylight. Thin chain, red string bracelet on the right wrist, navy shorts.

author: Cageside Press (no photo credit on the page)
notes: Near-frontal, raised brows, speaking into a microphone that hides the chin. Lakers jersey under a varsity jacket. Hot stage light.

author: Cageside Press (no photo credit on the page)
notes: Three-quarter view of his right side, fist up, white T-shirt. The hair is worn natural here: loose dark curls on top. Proves the texture is curly even though he usually slicks it back.

author: Cageside Press (no photo credit on the page)
notes: Frontal but with tinted glasses and a cap; useful only for the beard outline and his accessories (heavy gold chain with a gold pendant).
